questions.questionText: Hey! I'm Marco, an exchange student from Spain. Nice to meet you! Can you introduce yourself a little? — What do you do, and what do you like to do in your free time?
questions.questionTranslation: 안녕! 난 마르코고, 스페인에서 온 교환학생이야. 만나서 반가워! 자기소개를 간단히 해줄래? — 어떤 일을 하고, 여가 시간에는 뭘 즐겨 해?
requiredElements: State what you like to do in your free time.

questions.questionText: So, have you done anything fun or memorable lately?
questions.questionTranslation: 그럼, 최근에 했던 즐겁거나 기억에 남는 일 있어?
requiredElements: Share a recent fun or memorable experience, or state that you have not had one.

questions.questionText: If you could travel anywhere in the world next year, where would you go? And why there?
questions.questionTranslation: 내년에 세계 어디든 여행할 수 있다면, 어디로 가고 싶어? 그 이유는 뭐야?
requiredElements: Name a destination you would choose for next year.
Explain why you would choose that destination.

questions.questionText: Some of my friends say traveling alone is way better than traveling with friends. I'm not so sure though. What do you think?
questions.questionTranslation: 내 친구들 중엔 혼자 여행하는 게 친구랑 가는 것보다 훨씬 낫다는 애들이 있거든. 난 잘 모르겠던데. 넌 어떻게 생각해?
requiredElements: Express your view on traveling alone compared with traveling with friends.
